newsitem.title: FRANCE: France against renegotiating farm pact in at WTO.
newsitem.headline: France against renegotiating farm pact in at WTO.

text.p: France said on Wednesday that it strongly opposed proposals to start renegotiating the farm side of the 1994 GATT trade pact during the current World Trade Organisation ministerial meeting in Singapore.
"France will not tolerate that farm issues be discussed in Singapore," Philippe Vasseur told the annual meeting of the French CGB beet planters federation.
The ministerial meeting, which started on December 9, runs until December 13.
"France will respect the Marrakech agreements, all the Marrakech agreements and nothing but the Marrakech agreements," he added.
Vasseur was responding to French beet planters who have voiced concern over proposals by some WTO members to start renegotiating the farm side of the GATT deal before the agreed 1999 deadline.
